title: Chillayi Ye Zainab Mera Maara Gaya Bhai Allah Duhaayi
body:
Chillayi ye Zainab mera maara gaya bhayi Allah duhayi
Ek din mein mili khaak mein zehra ki kamai Allah duhayi
Sar par na raha koi jo bewaon ko bachaye aada hain dar, aye ab maut hi aajaye to ho sab ki rehayee Allah duhayi
Hain aag lagi jaye kahan moo ko chupane bachaon ko bacchane, beemar ko zalim ne hai zanjeer pehnayi Allah duhayi
<<DIVIDER>>
Bhabi se chhupa jaata hai besheer ka jhoola nanna wo shalooka, paani ke ewaz teer se hai pyaas bujhayi Allah duhayi
Nadaa ke Gohar chhin gaye aur kaan hain zakhmi bacchi hain tadapti, waaris jo nahi sar pe to dushman hain khudayi Allah duhayi
Abbas bahen teri museebat mein padi hain bedaad kadi hain, aa jald ghadi meri giraftari ki aayi Allah duhayi
Hyder ki bahu betiyaonke khulte hain ab sar hota nahi mehshar, ab layeqey parda nahi zehra ki ye jaayi Allah duhayi
<<DIVIDER>>
Qasim se kaho raat ki biyahi ki qabar le marti hai wo gham se, Akbar ho kahan aao nahi taab judai Allah duhayi
Taqdeer mein ye kuch tha abhi kya hai khabar kya tum chal basey bhaiyya, ab kya karon deta nahin kuch mujh ko sujhayi Allah duhayi..
